requestTiming.title: Request timing details
requestTiming.empty: No detailed trace is available. Historical records, unsupported protocols, expired traces and failed writes cannot be reconstructed. Retry shortly for a newly created record.
requestTiming.traceSelection: Actual requests linked to this billed record (latest 20)
requestTiming.scope: Timings cover the request as observed by Sub2API, not the full public network path. First output is measured during event parsing; flush does not prove client receipt. Read rate is not client bandwidth.
requestTiming.truncated: Collection limit reached; some spans were not retained.
requestTiming.overlap: Offsets start at request entry. Parent/child spans and reads/writes can overlap and must not be added. Gaps have no detailed instrumentation.

fields.first_semantic: First semantic event from request start
fields.first_visible: First visible output from request start
fields.wait_first_byte: Request written to first upstream byte

requestTiming.tpsNote: TPS is estimated from the usage record. Reasoning tokens, upstream buffering or a short post-first-token window may inflate it; it is not a direct measurement of model generation speed.

health.thresholds: Diagnostic reference bands, not an SLA. First output/upstream wait: green <10s, yellow 10–30s, orange 30–60s, red ≥60s. Total duration: green <60s, yellow 60–180s, orange 180–300s, red ≥300s. Local/connection stages: green <200ms, yellow 200–1000ms, orange 1–5s, red ≥5s. Long outputs and large bodies naturally take longer. Streaming duration, sizes, read rates and missing values are informational. New connections and missing EOF do not by themselves indicate failure.
health.largest: Longest observed local stage: {stage}, {time}. Stages may overlap; this does not establish a root cause.
health.failed: A request or downstream write failed. Check the result and upstream attempts below.
health.interrupted: The request was canceled, disconnected or incomplete. Check the result below.
health.insufficient: First-output data is missing; response speed cannot be assessed.
health.firstGood: Output began after about {time}, within the reference normal range.
health.firstSlow: Output began after about {time}, a longer wait. Compare body reads, queueing and upstream waits below.
health.attemptGuide: Egress #1 and physical HTTP #1.1 are layers of the same request, not a retry. HTTP status and transport completion are separate. Legacy cancellation may be caused by closing after completion and does not alone establish failure.

table.timePricingRowHint: Requests made within this period ({timezone} time) are billed at the prices in this row
table.timePricingRowHintWeekdays: On weekdays (Mon–Fri) only, requests made within this period ({timezone} time) are billed at the prices in this row; weekends use the standard prices
table.timePricingRowHintPeak: ; prices in this row exclude the peak-hour rate — where this period overlaps the peak hours {window}, the overlapping portion is additionally multiplied by ×{multiplier}

pelicanShowcase.title: Pelican Showcase
pelicanShowcase.description: Show users the HTML results of scheduled Pelican tests so they can see the model quality of each group. Disabled by default.
pelicanShowcase.configureLink: Go to Accounts and add plans from an account's action menu: Pelican Test > Scheduled tests
pelicanShowcase.enabledHint: Adds a "Pelican Showcase" page to the user sidebar. When off, the page is hidden and no new results are collected; kept results are still cleaned up by the rules below.
pelicanShowcase.groupsHint: Shows scheduled Pelican results of accounts in these groups. Only successful HTML is collected and account names are never shown. Results of a removed group are cleaned up within a minute.
pelicanShowcase.noGroups: No groups selected, so the user page will be empty.
pelicanShowcase.staleGroups: These selected groups were deleted or disabled and are not shown to users:
pelicanShowcase.groupsLoadFailed: Could not load groups. The saved selection is kept; refresh to retry.
pelicanShowcase.maxItemsHint: 1–100. The oldest result of a group is removed once the limit is exceeded.
pelicanShowcase.autoCleanupHint: Remove results older than the retention period. When off, only the count limit applies.
pelicanShowcase.independentNote: Showcased results are separate copies. They are not affected by the test history limits (keep N results, remove after 7 days) and stay visible after a test plan is deleted, until cleaned up by the rules here.

siteBillingMode.title: Site Billing Mode
siteBillingMode.description: Controls which purchase options users see. Defaults to "Recharge & Subscription".
siteBillingMode.label: Purchase options

hints.rechargeAndSubscription: Users can both top up their balance and buy subscription plans.
hints.rechargeOnly: Hides "My Subscriptions", the purchase-page subscription tab, the header subscription badge and the usage billing-type filter; direct visits to "My Subscriptions" return to the dashboard. The admin sidebar also hides the "Subscription Management" entry (the page stays reachable by URL). Existing subscription billing and redeem-code subscriptions are unaffected.
hints.subscriptionOnly: The purchase page only offers subscription plans and the sidebar entry reads "Subscription"; balance top-up orders are rejected. Redeem codes, affiliate payouts and other balance credits are unaffected.

modelPlaza.title: Model Plaza
modelPlaza.description: A public page showcasing available models and pricing by group. Disabled by default.
modelPlaza.enabledHint: When enabled, an entry appears in the header and the page is reachable at /model-plaza.
modelPlaza.requireAuthHint: When on, anonymous visitors are redirected to the login page; when off, the page is public and anonymous visitors only see non-exclusive groups.
modelPlaza.priceDescriptionHint: Rendered at the top of the plaza page. Use it for billing rules, exchange rates, promotions, etc.

pluginManagement.title: Plugin Management
pluginManagement.description: Controls whether the plugin management entry appears in the admin sidebar. This switch does not control plugin runtime state.
pluginManagement.enabledHint: Turning this off only hides the sidebar entry; loaded or running plugins are not stopped.
